app.name: Digital Fridge
app.tagline: What food you have, how much, and when it expires.

status.reviewNote: Past its best-before date: check it before eating

welcome.title: Name your home
welcome.body: This is where you'll keep track of your fridge, freezer and pantry.
welcome.join: I've been invited: join with a code

offline.noData: There's no saved data for this home. Connect to load it.

houses.title: Homes
houses.name: Home name
houses.notFound: You no longer belong to this home.
houses.expelBody: They will no longer see this home. The inventory stays as it is.

invite.title: Invitations
invite.body: Each code works for one person and expires after 7 days. Whoever receives it needs their own account.
invite.copied: Copied. Paste it wherever you want to send it.
invite.shareText: I'm inviting you to “{{house}}” on Digital Fridge. In the app, go to Settings → Homes → Join with a code and enter {{code}}. Or open this link:

houses.leaveBody: You will no longer see it. The inventory stays for everyone else.
houses.leaveBodyOwner: You will no longer see it, and ownership will pass to whoever has been there longest. The inventory stays for everyone else.
houses.deleteBody: It will be deleted for all its members, along with its inventory and history. This can't be undone.

join.title: Join a home
join.body: Enter the code you were given. Each code works only once.

export.title: Export
export.body: Save your profile and everything in your homes to a JSON file.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.body: This deletes your account, your profile and any home with nobody else in it. In shared homes, the inventory stays for everyone else and, if you were the owner, ownership passes to whoever has been there longest.
delete.sheetBody: This can't be undone. If you want to keep your data, export it first.

inventory.emptyBody: Add what you have and you'll always know what's there and when it expires.

add.title: Add
add.searchPlaceholder: What do you want to add?

form.dateType: What kind of date is it?
form.frozenHint: Anything in the freezer counts as frozen: it won't have a date unless you set a reminder date.
form.reminderHint: Helps you remember when to eat it.

errors.quantity: Enter a quantity greater than zero.
errors.content: Enter how much each one contains.
errors.dateType: Say whether it's a use-by or a best-before date.

leftover.title: Add leftovers
leftover.name: What it is
leftover.containerHint: Write it on the lid. If you leave it empty, the number shown is used.
leftover.invalidNumber: The container number must be a whole number greater than zero.

product.brandNotesPlaceholder: For example: didn't like the Auchan one
product.emptyTitle: There's none of this product left.

move.title: Move
move.freezeHint: Without a reminder date, it won't have a date while it's frozen.
move.thawHint: Without a reminder date, the printed date is used.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: It will stop appearing when you add products, and its preferred brand and notes will be lost. The history doesn't change.

errors.not_member: You don't belong to this home.
errors.not_owner: Only the owner of this home can do that.
errors.incompatible_product: That home already has a product with this name that's counted differently. Rename one of them and try again.
errors.invalid_invite: That code isn't valid, has already been used or has expired. Ask for another one.
errors.already_member: You already belong to that home.
errors.not_found: This no longer exists. Someone else may have changed it.
errors.invalid_input: Check the details and try again.
errors.nothing_to_consume: There's nothing left to take off.
errors.container_number_taken: That container number is already in use.
errors.undo_expired: Can't undo: more than 2 minutes have passed.
errors.undo_conflict: Can't undo: someone has changed it since.
errors.product_name_taken: There's already another product with that name.
errors.product_has_stock: There's still some of this product left.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

register.title: Create your account
register.checkInboxBody: We've sent a link to {{email}} to confirm your account.

forgot.title: Recover your password
forgot.body: We'll send you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.sent: If there's an account with that email, a link will arrive in a few minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.doneBody: If you use the installed app, go back to it and sign in with your new password.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email or password isn't right.
errors.emailTaken: There's already an account with that email. Try signing in.
errors.weakPassword: That password is too weak. Try a longer one.
errors.samePassword: Your new password must be different from the old one.
errors.signupDisabled: Sign-ups are closed. Ask whoever runs the app to open them.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a while and try again.
errors.emailNotAuthorized: We can't send email to that address yet. Ask whoever runs the app for help.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.expiredLink: That link is no longer valid. Request a new one from "I forgot my password".
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

config.missingBody: Create the .env.local file as explained in step 4 of SETUP.md and restart the app.
